title: Wear Mask by Bangladesh Police
overview: Directed by Borhan Khan under the production of Dreams In Frame and supervised by Dhaka Range, Bangladesh Police, the awareness short "Wear Mask" is an impactful TV public service announcement (OVC). The plot follows an indifferent individual stepping out unprotected, oblivious to the hidden danger. Realizing negligence endangers his loved ones, he learns from the police's message that wearing a mask is a crucial shield, promoting safety across television screens.
